statement: An array of n distinct integers was sorted in ascending order and then rotated between 1 and n times. Rotating once moves the last element to the front, so [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7] rotated 4 times becomes [4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], and rotated n times it is back where it started.
Given the rotated array nums, return its minimum element.
The search must run in O(log n) time. At each step one half of the range is sorted, and the smallest value of a sorted half is its first element; record it and continue in the other half.

examples.explanation: The array is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] rotated so that 6 and 7 come first. The minimum is 1, right after the drop from 7.
The values fall from 7 to 0 at index 4, and 0 is the smallest element.
This array was rotated a full n times, so it is fully sorted and the minimum is its first element, 1.

constraints: All the integers of nums are unique
nums is sorted and rotated between 1 and n times
